en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a small landscaped park with paths, lawns, and low fencing in the foreground. Several early 20th‑century detached wooden houses with verandas and steep roofs line the far side of the park. There is a white gate at the right front and a flagpole within the park. Trees and light poles are visible in the background. The word "Arvidsjaur" is printed in small white letters at the bottom left.
